title: When you get caught eating the last pizza slice
caption:
POV: you get caught eating the last slice
She's mid cheese-pull in pure bliss when he walks in and asks what she's doing, so she hides the slice behind her back, then shyly offers it to him instead.
Because pizza tastes better when you split it with your favorite person.
Would you share your last slice or hide it too?
Share this with the person you'd split it with, and follow for more cozy little stories.
